title: Portland Table Tennis Club

services.name: Classes
services.desc: Please note that classes and competitions are paid for separately from use of the club facilities. When you enter you will login to pay for the facility. All classes and competitions are paid for separately. If you have a class, or if you are playing in a competition, please see Sandy to pay for the competition or for your lesson. Saturday mornings at 10:00 - 11:00 AM there is a kids class for those 8 and up. Just show up! Cost $15 including the facility fee. Mondays from 3:45 - 4:45 PM there is a class for middle schoolers. Just show up! Cost $15 including the facility fee. Mondays 7 -8 PM there is a class set up through Portland Community College. Consult them for registration. The PCC
